description: This file defines the OrleansMessageRejectionException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans.Runtime namespace to indicate that an Orleans message was rejected. It includes multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios, including serialization support.

classes.name: OrleansMessageRejectionException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that an Orleans message was rejected, derived from OrleansException.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message.
